notes_for_editor: Register-only record for this tower: no tower-specific page or news item found in two searches. Brief lists access as closed; the register shows drive access and an active status, so the story uses restricted (see corrections). The brief has no local_unit for this tower, so the story names no municipality. Staffing text is Alberta's program-wide description, not a tower-specific record. The story says Round Hill is among the register's lookouts, which follows from the layer being the province's lookout list.
